# Copilot instructions: FHIDev/Fhi.Munin.Explorer

The instructions for every agent in this repo are in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md): the gates before a PR, the rules
that fail silently, the conventions, accessibility, publishing and the team's rules. Read it first.

When reviewing a pull request, follow `REVIEW.md` and `.github/instructions/code-review.instructions.md`: what an
Important finding is, at most 5 Nits, `file:line` evidence, and a summary that starts with a count.
